load_model_from_pretrained: load a Hugging Face causal language model and tokenizer from a model ID string
load_dataset_from_huggingface: load a Hugging Face dataset split and shuffle it with a fixed seed
create_awq_quantization_recipe: create an AWQ quantization recipe with FP8_DYNAMIC scheme targeting Linear layers
run_oneshot_quantization: run oneshot quantization on a model using a calibration dataset and quantization recipe
generate_text_with_quantized_model: generate text from a quantized model and decode the output tokens
